title: Select [EXISTS]
description:
## EXISTS
EXISTS checks if a subquery returns ANY rows. It returns true or false.
```sql
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders
    WHERE orders.user_id = users.id
);
```
This finds all users who have at least one order. The subquery doesn't need to return specific data - just whether rows exist.

`NOT EXISTS` does the opposite - finds rows where the subquery returns nothing.
```sql
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders
    WHERE orders.user_id = users.id
);
```
This finds users with NO orders.
